# Layout Examples

布局组件通常组合使用，先确定容器，再选择 Space/Grid/List 等局部排版组件。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## Carousel

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/carousel/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/carousel/`.

Note: 子节点才是 slides。`infinite` 在 scroll 下走首尾 clone，不会整段倒带。无名不是 landmark。非当前页 `inert`。开 autoplay 时有可聚焦暂停；`autoplaySpeed<=0` 和 reduced-motion 都不自动播。

Vue: `<Carousel><div>One</div><div>Two</div></Carousel>`

React: `<Carousel><div>One</div><div>Two</div></Carousel>`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
